title: Some Supabase customers are publicly exposing reams of people’s data to the web
content_md: Zack Whittaker reports today’s nominee for the “No need to hack when it’s leaking” honors: Thousands of databases hosted by development platform Supabase are exposing people’s sensitive information to the public web, new security research by cybersecurity firm UpGuard has found.
